method_notes: Brands were found with WebSearch and page reads (AJC, Rough Draft Atlanta, Secret Atlanta, Phoenix New Times, What Now, ma.to, Luma, Eventbrite) before our data was opened. Our data (events.json, sources.json, watchlist.json, review/*) was read only afterwards.

data/events.json only holds events starting 2026-10-24 or later. A pop-up before that date is marked found_by_our_data 'no' with data_window_note 'before events.json window'; that is a coverage-window effect, not proof the pipeline could not have found it.

Instagram and TikTok were never fetched. Instagram evidence is only a handle or post link printed on a press or venue page, so posted_at is null and readable_without_login is 'partial' by platform rule, not tested.

The search tool did not index Reddit, Posh, Partiful, Google Business posts or Linktrees for these brands, and surfaced only a few Luma pages; absence of those channels is a search limit, not evidence they do not exist.

Several brands are weak fits: Ponder Coffee, Stroll Coffee, Yumi's Coffee and Soundtrack Coffee are coffee carts or residencies that serve matcha, not matcha-only brands; The Postcard is a permanent cafe whose dated pop-up is a workshop at a host venue; Neighbor Matcha is a workshop host.
